result.reason: Neither position is fully satisfied. The redline adds a workmanlike-performance warranty, a 90-day Site warranty, malicious-code protection, correction/re-performance, and a contingent refund. It omits an express services-warranty duration, replacement, and compliance with laws; it also limits conformance to material respects and provides no 12-month software period. The remedy language is ambiguous because it refers to “this warranty,” focuses on non-conforming services, and makes refund contingent on failed correction. Unrelated corporate-authority warranties remain operative, and no direct contradiction is introduced.
